name: How can I maximize space in a small bathroom layout?

mainEntity.name: How can I maximize space in a small bathroom layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: To maximize space in a small bathroom, consider a wall-mounted or corner sink, which frees up valuable floor space. Opt for a floating vanity to enhance the perception of openness. A walk-in shower with a frameless glass enclosure, or even a wet room design, can make the bathroom feel larger than a traditional tub/shower combo. Utilize vertical space with recessed shelving or tall, narrow storage units. Sliding or pocket doors also eliminate the need for swing clearance, further optimizing the layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize space with wall-mounted fixtures, floating vanities, walk-in showers, vertical storage, and space-saving doors.
